parts.text:
This is a 3 by 3 diagram.
The diagram shows:
• 6 horizontal connectors
• 4 up diagonal connectors.
Each connector joins 2 dots.
Complete the diagram by drawing the 6 vertical connectors and the 4 down diagonal connectors
that join 2 dots.

parts.text:

On this 4 by 4 diagram,

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: draw the horizontal connectors and the vertical connectors that join 2 dots,

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: In an n by n diagram there are n rows and n columns.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Find an expression, in terms of n, for the number of up diagonal connectors that join 2 dots on
an n by n diagram.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Find an expression, in terms of n, for the number of horizontal connectors that join 2 dots on
an n by n diagram.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Use your answers to part (d) to find the total number of connectors that join 2 dots on a 15 by 15
diagram.

2 This is a 3 by 3 diagram.
There are 8 ways to join 3 dots.
These are:
• 3 vertical connectors
• 3 horizontal connectors
• 1 up diagonal connector
• 1 down diagonal connector.
